promised_vs_delivered.delivered: FIN shows cycle days at 135.05 days in FY26, missing the target range of 70 to 85 days.
FIN shows FY26 FCF at -₹1,841 crore and CFO at -₹600 crore, indicating capex of ~₹1,241 crore against ~₹400 crore planned.
No segment financial breakdown for rail growth in Q1 FY27 (C1) or later statements.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: C2 claims core EMS working capital days reduced from 83 days in FY24 to 53 days in FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN reported working capital cycle days increased from 110.46 days in FY24 to 135.05 days in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: C1 claims total revenue grew 40% year-on-year to INR946 crores in Q1 FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN shows Jun 2026 revenue at ₹946 crore, reflecting a 40.6% YoY growth from ₹673 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: C2 claims EBITDA for FY26 registered 39.8% growth translating to a 15.8% margin.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FIN shows FY26 operating profit grew 38.9% to ₹578 crore with an OPM of 15.9%.

bull.point: Revenue grew at 47.7% CAGR over 3 years to ₹3,626 crore in FY26, supported by an order book of ₹9,000 crore.
Operating profit margins have remained resilient, expanding from 13.5% in FY22 to 15.9% in FY26.
OSAT business progress is supported by ₹170 crore in government subsidies received till July 2026.

bear.point: Cash flows deteriorated severely with CFO at -₹600 crore and FCF at -₹1,841 crore in FY26.
Working capital cycle widened to 135.05 days in FY26, driven by debtor days rising to 105.85 days.
PAT declined 25.3% YoY in Jun 2026 quarter to ₹56 crore despite 40.6% top-line growth.

watch.point: Recovery in negative operating cash flow (-₹600 crore in FY26) and reduction in receivables cycle.
Smart metering segment performance and potential divestment or restructuring process.
Gross margin trends and impact of potential component shortages and price increases.
